$comment: Register of the Storybooks the documentation site publishes beside its pages.
A page can embed a story live instead of a picture of it (`<StorybookStory>`, see the
blong-docs skill). That needs the story to be served from somewhere, and the answer is
the docs site itself: each site here is built by its own package and staged into
`static/storybook/<name>/`, so it is published by the same `npm run deploy` and served
from the same origin as the page that embeds it @@D-556.
The staged tree is NOT committed: it is a build output, 10-30 MB per site, ignored by
`docs/blong/.gitignore`, and rebuilt by `blong-dev docs storybook` before a deploy. So a
plain `npm run build` — the CI shape — still builds the site without it, every embed
degrades to its poster, and `blong-dev docs verify` counts the embeds that rendered
rather than the stories they would have loaded.
Read and used by `blong-dev docs storybook`
(tools/blong-dev/src/docs/storybookSites.ts):
blong-dev docs storybook [--only <name[,name]>] [--no-build] [--dry-run]
Fields:
name     the directory name under static/storybook/, and the `site` of an embed
title    what the site is, for the command's summary
package  repository-relative package the build runs in (its working directory)
command  build command, run in `package`; it must write `output`
output   directory the command writes, relative to `package`
Adding a site is adding an entry here and embedding `site="<name>"`. A story id an
embed names is checked against the staged site's own `index.json` on every publish, so a
renamed story is caught by the build rather than by a reader.
Two sites rather than one composed build: a component story is rendered by
blong-browser's own preview (its in-file `withDispatch` fixtures, no platform) and a model
page story by a realm's (a platform, a mock adapter, the toolbar). One preview file per
Storybook is what decides which of the two a story gets, so composing them would render
the component stories against the wrong fixtures @@D-557.

sites.name: browser
sites.title: blong-browser: the component library's own stories
